subject: Quarterframe prep — forecast scan + account traffic-light summaries
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-14T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quarterframe prep — forecast scan + account traffic-light summaries

Team — kicking off a compact prep thread for the Quarterframe (QBR) next week. I want a tight, account-by-account view that leadership can scan in under 5 minutes per major deal. High-level asks below: 

1) Forecast sanity check: mark any deal where our internal confidence <> 70% vs. listed forecast. If confidence is lower, add a 1-line reason.
2) Traffic-light snapshot (green/amber/red) per account with the primary riser / blocker.
3) One mutual action item (MAP) and owner for each account — include dates.

Marissa — can you run the traffic-light workbook for the field and attach a pivot of top 12 deals? Please include list of recent exec touches.
Aditya — please add any leadership-level asks (credit/override/contract slack) you foresee so we can pre-approve.
Tessa — I’ll need a 1-slide summary for the leadership pack showing total upside vs risked forecast.

Timing: can we close this by COB Monday PST so we have time to stitch the deck? I’ve dropped a starter workbook into Drive (link below) — populate the account tab directly.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QFRAME_PREP
Attachment: Quarterframe_account_traffic_light.xlsx (workbook with traffic-light template)

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarterframe prep — forecast scan + account traffic-light summaries

Mina / team — attaching a first pass. I ran the field pivot and trimmed to the top 14 deals by ARR exposure. Quick notes inline. Attachment: Quarterframe_account_traffic_light.xlsx (sheet: TOP14 + notes)

Quick highlights (TL;DR):
- BrightLayer (Green -> Amber): exec meeting last week went well; legal now asking for data-retention language. MAP: Legal intake + draft redline (owner: Linda; internal owner: Aditya). Target: 2026-11-21.
- AlphaEdge (Amber -> Red): procurement delayed three weeks for SSO + SOC evidence; renewal window compressed. MAP: SSO PoC + SOC snapshots (owner: Simon). Need escalation path if we miss 11/30 close.
- Three smaller accounts flagged green but low visibility — recommended light outreach.

I added a brief confidence column (FieldConfidence) and short rationale. I also linked HubSpot records for top deals.

Next steps: Aditya, can you confirm whether the legal ask from BrightLayer can be handled within standard terms or requires SKU-level exception? Tessa — once we lock the MAPs I’ll convert the workbook row into the leadership slide.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarterframe prep — forecast scan + account traffic-light summaries

Thanks Marissa — good work. A couple of leadership notes from procurement/legal side: 

- BrightLayer: Data-retention clause request — likely OK under our standard enterprise addendum if we accept retention up to 18 months with cataloged deletion SOP. I’ve asked legal for a clean addendum template (ETA: 48 hours). If legal pushes back, we should consider a one-time credit for migration assistance; I estimate $8k-$12k one-off.

- AlphaEdge: SSO and SOC asks are heavier. We can supply SOC snapshots and a scoped SSO integration plan, but procurement timeline is tight. Recommend an early escalation to CS + Solutions so we can offer a targeted SSO pilot (2-week PoC) and a bridging MSA amendment. If we need SLA concessions, raise now — I can draft a term sheet for review.

I attached the BrightLayer MAP (BrightLayer_MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf) and linked the HubSpot opportunities HS-5421789 and HS-5429011 for AlphaEdge.

Marquee asks for leadership: pre-approve up to $15k of one-time migration/transition credits across pipeline to accelerate closes where legal asks would otherwise delay beyond quarter close. If leadership wants a tighter cap, advise.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-16T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quarterframe prep — forecast scan + account traffic-light summaries

All — thanks. I pulled the top-line slide and inserted two bars: Risked Forecast vs Un-risked Upside and a traffic-light thumbnail for the 14 deals. Notes:

- If leadership green-lights the $15k credit pool, we can recover ~+$420k of at-risk ARR in the quarter (field estimate). I marked which deals are candidates in the workbook.
- For AlphaEdge I recommend we prepare an "SSO bridge" slide with delivery milestones and a named solution architect to commit to dates. That buys credibility during procurement.

I attached the slide deck stub to Drive (link below) and pushed the updated slide into the leadership folder. If no objections, I’ll finalize and send to the exec pack by EOD Tuesday.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QFRAME_PREP

Tessa
